name: Scope Spectrum
description: Oscilloscope and spectrum analyser for the master output or the line input, one app with a View parameter. SCOPE: rising zero-crossing trigger with a free-run fallback and five fixed time spans (2.9 to 34.8 ms). SPECTRUM: 1024-point FFT with a Hann window, 48 log-frequency bars from 40 Hz to 20 kHz, a 60 dB scale and a falling peak-hold line. Reads the OS's audio tap (ABI 1.4, capability audio_tap); it makes no sound. New Community OS behaviour.
